## Packages needed

```{r}
#| label: loading packages05
#| message: false
library("readr")
library("tidyverse")
```

## Sub Figure 1A

### Load data for Sub figure 1A

```{r}
#load the data
data_subfig1A <- read_rds("../data/03_sf1a_aug.rds")

```

### Generate plot for sub figure 1A

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8
#| dpi: 300

# Define the exact display order of the 9 target genes (fills left-to-right, top-to-bottom)
gene_order <- c("RIN", "TDR4", "FUL2", "ACS2", "ACS4", "PSY1", "PG2A", "CNR", "GRAS")
gene_labels <- c("RIN (rin)", "FUL1", "FUL2", "ACS2", "ACS4", "PSY1", "PG2A", "CNR", "GRAS")

SubFig1A_plot <- data_subfig1A |> 
  filter(Gene_Name %in% gene_order) |>   # Keep only the 9 genes needed for Figure 1A
  mutate(Gene_Name = factor(Gene_Name, levels = gene_order, labels = gene_labels)) |> # Makes sure the graphs are in the correct order

  ggplot(aes(x = Age, 
             y = mean_norm, 
             fill = Dataset)) + 
  
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.75) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4f81bd", 
                               "#c0504d", 
                               "#9bbb59")) +
  
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = mean_norm, 
        ymax = mean_norm + sd_norm),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_norm + sd_norm, 
        ymax = mean_norm + sd_norm),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.3,
    linewidth = 0.5,
    color = "grey") +
  
  # Make the correct arrangement of the plots 3x3
  facet_wrap(~ Gene_Name, ncol = 3, scales = "free_x") +

 # Small vertical tick between G and P
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1.5, xend = 1.5,
    y = 0, yend = -0.15,
    colour = "gray",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # Sets the y-axis window from 0 to 4 without cutting off the tick at yend = -0.15
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 4), clip = "off") +
  
  # Controls the y-axis tick numbers (0.0, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0)
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 0:4,
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Gene_Name, ncol = 3, scales = "free_x") +
  
  
  labs(y = "Relative expression",  # Shared label
       x = NULL) +
  
  theme_bw() + 
  
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1, # Square plots
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.8, "lines"), # Horizontal spacing between columns
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines"), # Vertical spacing between rows
    strip.background = element_blank(), # Remove header from each individual plot
    strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold.italic", margin = margin(b = 3)),
    strip.clip = "off", # Prevents overlap issues
    
    # Legend box styling
    legend.position = "bottom", 
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.45, "cm"),
    legend.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.4), 
    
    # Axis titles and tick labels
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 8)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(), # Hides small tick marks on axes
    
    # Gridlines and panel borders
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),# Removes vertical gridlines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # Removes minor gridlines
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "gray", linewidth = 0.4), # Keeps horizontal gridlines
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "gray", fill = NA, linewidth = 1) # Border around each square
  )

# Save the file for results
ggsave(
  filename = "../results/04_SubFig1A.png",
  plot = SubFig1A_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

SubFig1A_plot
```

## Sub Figure 1B

### Load data for sub figure 1B

```{r}
#load the data
data_subfig1B <- read_rds("../data/03_sf1b_aug.rds")

```

```{r}
# Defining the equation and the R^2 value of the linear fit for later
fit <- lm(mean_norm ~ RNA_seq_FC, data = data_subfig1B)

intercept <- round(coef(fit)[1], 3)
slope <- round(coef(fit)[2], 3)
r2 <- round(summary(fit)$r.squared, 3)

# Build the formatted label string (handles + or - sign automatically)
sign_str <- if_else(intercept >= 0, "+", "-")
eq_line  <- str_glue("bold('y = {slope}x {sign_str} {abs(intercept)}')")
r2_line  <- str_glue("bold('R'^2*' = {r2}')")

# Plotting
subfig1B_plot <- data_subfig1B %>% 
  ggplot(aes( x = RNA_seq_FC,
              y = mean_norm))+
  
  # Diamond shapes for points
  geom_point(shape = 18, size = 2, color = "black")+
  
  geom_smooth(method = lm, 
              formula = y ~x, 
              linetype = "11", 
              linewidth = 0.9, 
              color = "black", 
              se = FALSE)+
  
  # Inserting the equation and R^2 in the plot
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.8, y = 2.5,
    label = eq_line,
    parse = TRUE,
    size = 5.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.8, y = 2.2,
    label = r2_line,
    parse = TRUE,
    size = 5.5
  ) +
  
  labs(x = "Relative expression in RNA-seq", 
       y = "Relative expression in qRT-PCR")+
  
  # Make the plot start in (0,0)
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0,0)
  )+
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = c(0,0)
  )+
  
  theme_minimal()+
  
  #Formatting the plot to look like the original
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1, # Square plot
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
  )

# Save the file for results
ggsave(
  filename = "../results/04_SubFig1B.png",
  plot = subfig1B_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

subfig1B_plot
```
